one_line: Agentic B2B support platform that tracks customer issues across Slack, email, Microsoft Teams, chat widgets, and forms, and orchestrates AI agents to resolve them.
auth_notes: REST API authenticated with API keys issued in the Pylon app; docs also cover Custom Apps and embedded iframes. OAuth2 not confirmed from evidence.
self_serve_notes: Self-serve signup available; API credentials obtainable solo without sales, though advanced support/enterprise features may require a paid tier.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Endpoints across issues, accounts, contacts, conversations, messages, analytics; tens of endpoints.
api_surface.webhook_note: Docs include a dedicated Webhooks section for receiving issue/message events.

existing_mcp.note: Docs navigation lists a dedicated 'Pylon MCP' section (docs.usepylon.com).

evidence.note: Fetched text (015_pylon.txt) shows API, Custom Apps, Webhooks, and Pylon MCP sections. Exact auth method inferred from knowledge.

agent_notes: Text confirms B2B positioning and API/MCP existence but does not state the exact auth method or free-tier availability.
